name: Everest Base Camp Trek
description: The big one. Walk through Sherpa villages to the foot of the world's highest peak. It's tough but the views are unbeatable.

gallery.title: Everest Base Camp
gallery.note: Right at the bottom of the world's tallest mountain.

name: Annapurna Circuit Trek
description: A classic loop. You'll see everything from green forests to high-altitude deserts and cross a massive mountain pass.

gallery.title: Thorong La Pass
gallery.note: The highest point of the trek.

name: Langtang Valley Trek
description: Close to Kathmandu and very welcoming. Great for seeing local culture and dramatic valley views without the EBC crowds.

gallery.title: Langtang Valley Floor
gallery.note: Walking through the heart of the valley.

name: Ghorepani Poon Hill Trek
description: Short, sweet, and perfect for beginners. The sunrise view from the top is one of the best in Nepal.

name: Manaslu Circuit Trek
description: A bit more 'wild' than the others. It's a remote circuit around a stunning peak with fewer tourists.

name: Upper Mustang Trek
description: Like walking on another planet. Dry, red cliffs and ancient walled cities. Perfect if you want to avoid the rain.

name: Mardi Himal Trek
description: A hidden gem. A shorter ridge trek that gets you incredibly close to the iconic 'Fishtail' mountain.

gallery.title: Machhapuchhre View
gallery.note: The mountain that looks like a fish tail.

name: Gosaikunda Lake Trek
description: A sacred lake high in the mountains. The climb is steady, and the lakes at the top are crystal blue.

gallery.title: Sacred Gosaikunda Lake
gallery.note: A very important place for locals.

name: Kanchenjunga Base Camp Trek
description: A long, wild journey to the far east of Nepal. Only for experienced hikers who want a real adventure.

name: Khopra Ridge Trek
description: A quiet alternative to the busy trails. You stay in community lodges and get great views of the Dhaulagiri range.

gallery.title: Khopra Ridge View
gallery.note: A peaceful ridge with stunning views.
